title: Studio Interfaces: a draft-only object's nav entry opens a non-existent 'Default view', and the first edit there creates a second default list view
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnE9YNkSZen7sijLA3

Filing gate: class a (a user-visible defect, reached through a public door), reported by the dev of PR #30175 (#30046) in its `out_of_scope_findings`. The seat carries it, because devs do not file. ⛔ Not a claim. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## Business reason

Someone building a new app in Studio adds an object and a list view, and both are still drafts. They open the object from the app's navigation, and the view dropdown offers "Default view", a view that does not exist, beside the one they made. If they edit it, the package gets a second default list view. A new column list made there also starts empty.

## Reproduce (dev's browser reading on PR #30175's branch; not repeated by the seat)

1. Use a writable fresh package, for example `com.acme.trial`, containing the draft-only object `acmetrial_deal`, a drafted list view `acmetrial_deal.all` with `isDefault: true`, and a navigation entry for the object with no `viewName`.
2. Open the entry in Studio → Interfaces. It opens `acmetrial_deal.default`, which does not exist. The switcher lists "Default view" beside "All deals".
3. Make the first edit there. It would create a second default view.

## Cause (dev's code reading, not seat-verified)

`listViewTargetOf` resolves the entry's view only from the shell's merged `listViews` (`metadata.objects`), and a draft-only object is absent from that. Related: Create View seeds zero columns there, because `defaultListColumnsFromObject` gets an undefined object definition. The dev reports the same behaviour with the old panel picker, so it predates #30175.

## Dedupe (open and closed)

`listViewTargetOf` → 4 hits, none about this. `defaultListColumnsFromObject` → 1 hit (#30046). `draft-only object default view` → nearest is #29814 (a pending draft has no untranslated author-owned read), which is a different read path. **New.**

## Re-check

`git grep -n "function listViewTargetOf\|listViewTargetOf =" origin/main -- ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design`
